messages.en: Forked sessions keep the same permissions as the source session.

分享已创建，但插件端点未保存；请到分享权限中重试。
messages.en: The share was created, but its plugin endpoints were not saved; retry in Share permissions.

messages.zh: 对这个分享统一选一个档位；档位在保存时展开成插件当前声明的全部端点，之后新增的端点不会自动开放。
messages.en: Choose one tier for this share; the tier expands at save time into the endpoints the plugins declare now, so endpoints they add later stay closed.

messages.zh: 当前没有插件声明可分享端点。
messages.en: No plugin currently declares endpoints to share.

messages.zh: 没有插件提供只读端点，因此不能选择「可读」。
messages.en: No plugin offers a read-only endpoint, so Read-only cannot be chosen.

messages.en: No plugin offers a writable endpoint, so Writable cannot be chosen.

messages.zh: 当前记录不是整档选择；重新保存会按所选档位覆盖。
messages.en: The saved selection is not one whole tier; saving again replaces it with the tier you pick.

messages.zh: 可写 · {readable} 只读 + {writable} 可写
可写端点在被分享会话允许写入时才生效，且在可写分享中具有破坏性。
messages.en: A writable endpoint takes effect only when the shared Session allows writing, and is destructive inside a writable share.

messages.zh: 正在测试分享服务地址连通性…
messages.en: Testing whether the share service address answers…

messages.zh: 未能复制链接。请选中分享链接后手动复制。
messages.en: Could not copy the link. Select the share link and copy it manually.

messages.zh: 部署还配置了 {count} 个可访问身份；访问范围不只由此处选择决定。
messages.en: Deployment-authorized identities: {count}. Selection is not the only access rule.

messages.zh: 创建一个只读 Liveshare 链接：{title}
messages.en: Create a read-only Liveshare link for {title}

messages.zh: 只分享这个会话；对方能做什么由“会话权限”决定，随时可以在“管理分享”里停止。
messages.en: Shares this Session only; the session permission decides what the viewer may do, and you can stop it any time in Manage shares.

messages.zh: 无法连接 DSH Liveshare 分享服务。
messages.en: Cannot reach the DSH Liveshare share service.

messages.zh: 登录已过期，请重新登录后再创建分享。
messages.en: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again before creating a share.

messages.zh: 无法打开登录窗口（可能被浏览器拦截）。请允许弹窗后重试。
messages.en: Cannot open the sign-in window (the browser may have blocked it). Allow pop-ups and try again.

messages.zh: 已取消登录，未保存任何凭据。
messages.en: Sign-in cancelled; no credential was saved.

messages.zh: 登录已完成，正在读取状态。
messages.en: Signed in; reading the account state.

messages.zh: 这次登录已过期，请重新发起。

messages.en: Sign-in did not finish. Try again.

messages.zh: 登录回答不属于本次请求，已忽略。
messages.en: The sign-in answer did not belong to this request and was ignored.

messages.zh: 这次登录已被使用过，请重新发起。
messages.en: This sign-in was already used; start again.

messages.zh: 无法发起登录：Relay 不可用或该地址尚不支持。
messages.en: Cannot start sign-in: the Relay is unavailable or this address does not support it.

messages.zh: 请在打开的窗口中完成登录。
messages.en: Finish signing in in the window that opened.

messages.zh: 当前登录属于另一个 Relay 地址，请在本地址重新登录。
messages.en: The current sign-in belongs to another Relay address. Sign in again on this address.

messages.zh: 当前 Relay 地址还不支持身份认证，请先升级 Relay 后再创建分享；不会创建匿名分享。
messages.en: The Relay at this address does not verify identities yet. Upgrade it before creating a share; this page will not create an anonymous one.

messages.zh: 已在有效授权内自动续期。
messages.en: Renewed automatically within the granted authorization.

messages.zh: 登录状态暂时不可用，请稍后重试；登录前不会创建分享。
messages.en: Sign-in status is unavailable right now. Try again later; no share is created before you sign in.

messages.zh: 尚未登录，无法创建分享。
messages.en: You are not signed in, so you cannot create a share.

messages.zh: 请先保存地址并确认可连接，再登录。
messages.en: Save the address and confirm it answers before signing in.

messages.zh: 关闭此面板不会停止分享。
messages.en: Closing this panel does not stop the share.

messages.zh: 组织内任何持链接的人可查看
messages.en: Anyone in the organization with the link

messages.zh: 还没有分享出去的会话
正在校验本机能否在该地址发布分享…
messages.en: Checking whether this host may publish at this address…

messages.zh: 权限校验未完成（Host 未给出原因）。
messages.en: The permission check did not finish (the Host reported no reason).

messages.zh: 已登录，本机可以发布分享。
messages.en: Signed in; this host can publish shares.

messages.zh: 需要先校验权限，才能创建分享。
messages.en: This address must be checked before a share can be created.

messages.zh: 有未保存的改动；再次点击「完成」将丢弃它们。
messages.en: Unsaved changes; choosing Done again discards them.

messages.zh: 分享权限未保存，请重试。
messages.en: The share permissions were not saved. Try again.

messages.zh: 此 Harness 未回读会话权限，不能在这里修改。
messages.en: This Harness did not report a session permission, so it cannot be changed here.

messages.zh: 会话权限已更新，但插件端点未保存，请重试。
messages.en: The session permission was updated, but the plugin endpoints were not saved. Try again.

messages.zh: 已保存分享权限与插件端点。
messages.en: Share permissions and plugin endpoints saved.

messages.zh: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的完整地址。
messages.en: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.

messages.zh: 地址已更换，请在新地址重新登录。
messages.en: The address changed; sign in again on the new address.

messages.zh: 已保存，新的分享将使用该地址。
messages.en: Saved. New shares use this address.

messages.zh: 这个地址尚未保存；保存后才会生效。
messages.en: This address is not saved yet; save it to put it in force.

messages.zh: 分享服务已确认 {count} 位所选人员。
这是旧版“指定同事可看”的分享：范围保持不变，新建分享只能选择上面两种方式。
messages.en: This share keeps its older "specific colleagues" scope; new shares offer only the two modes above.

messages.zh: 仅可查看：观看者可以读取分享范围内的文件与会话记录，也能向这个会话发消息；所有工具都在只读沙箱中运行，不能写文件。
messages.en: Read only: viewers read files and the session record within the share's scope and can message the session, but every tool runs in a read-only sandbox and no file can be written.

messages.zh: 工作区内修改：观看者在可写沙箱里工作——可以在分享范围内修改文件，写入受可写上限约束；分享范围之外的读写都会被拒绝，你的全局设置、凭据与其它会话仍不开放。
messages.en: Workspace write: the viewer works in a bounded writable sandbox — it modifies files inside the share’s scope under the writable ceiling; reads and writes beyond that scope are refused, and your global settings, credentials, and other Sessions stay closed.

messages.zh: 此 Harness 未回读会话权限：所有者端版本过旧时请先升级，再重新创建分享。
messages.en: This Harness did not report the session permission back: an older owner build needs an upgrade before the share can carry it.

messages.zh: 停止分享失败，请稍后重试。
messages.en: Failed to stop sharing. Try again.

messages.zh: Relay 连接失败（服务端未给出原因）。
messages.en: Relay connection failed (the Host reported no reason).

messages.zh: Relay HTTP 可访问，但注册未完成（服务端未给出原因）；仍可创建，网关会自动重试。
messages.en: Relay HTTP is reachable but registration did not finish and the Host reported no reason. You can still create the share; the gateway retries.

messages.zh: 设置「{title}」是否允许观看者分叉会话
查看每个分享的在线状态与访问范围。
messages.en: View the online state and access scope of every share.

历史记录读取失败，请重试。
messages.en: Could not load history. Try again.

messages.zh: 登录凭据已过期：只影响新建分享。下列已发布分享不受影响，链接仍可复制、仍可管理。
messages.en: This sign-in has expired, which blocks creating new shares only. The shares published below are unaffected: their links still copy and stay manageable.

messages.zh: 会话权限未保存，请重试。
messages.en: The session permission was not saved. Try again.

messages.zh: 此 Harness 未回读会话权限，无法在这里设置。
messages.en: This Harness did not report a session permission, so it cannot be set here.

messages.zh: 我明白已发布的链接会立即失效
messages.en: I understand the published link stops working immediately

messages.zh: 已发布的链接会立即失效，正在查看的人将无法继续访问。
messages.en: The published link stops working immediately, and anyone viewing it loses access.

messages.zh: 无法获取分享列表，显示的是最后一次已知状态。
messages.en: Could not load shares. Showing the last known state.

messages.zh: 这个会话还没有可显示的内容。
messages.en: This session has no content to show yet.

messages.zh: 该分享已过期，不再提供访问。请联系分享者重新分享。
messages.en: This share expired and no longer grants access. Ask the owner to share again.

messages.zh: 这个会话正在使用的模型，由分享者决定
messages.en: The model this Session runs on, chosen by the owner who shared it

messages.zh: 分享暂时离线，稍后会自动重连。
messages.en: The share is offline. It reconnects automatically.

messages.zh: 这份分享的会话权限，由分享者决定
messages.en: The session permission this share carries, set by the owner

messages.zh: 这些分享创建于身份验证之前，访问范围保持不变。
messages.en: These shares predate verified identities; their access is unchanged.

messages.zh: 仅可查看：可以驱动这个会话，但只能在分享范围内读取文件，不能修改内容。
messages.en: Read only: you can drive this Session, but you read files inside the share’s scope only and modify nothing.

messages.zh: 此 Host 尚未安装只读执行上限
messages.en: This Host has not installed the read-only execution limits

messages.zh: 分支会话已创建，但沙箱限制安装失败，无法使用
messages.en: The branch Session was created, but its sandbox limits could not be installed, so it cannot be used

messages.en: The owner does not allow branching this Session

messages.zh: 这次分支请求指定的前缀与之前那次不同，未再新建会话
messages.en: This branch request named a different prefix than the earlier one, so no new Session was created

messages.zh: Host 未能准备好此分支，本次操作没有执行
messages.en: The Host could not prepare this branch, so this action did not run

messages.zh: 该分支来源的分享已不可用
messages.en: The share this branch came from is no longer active

messages.zh: 此会话不是分享产生的分支
messages.en: This Session is not a branch of a share

messages.zh: 该分支属于其他观看者
messages.en: That branch belongs to another viewer

messages.zh: 中继未确认你的身份，无法完成分支
messages.en: The Relay did not confirm your identity, so the branch cannot be created

messages.zh: 这个会话不在你持有的分享范围内，未写入
messages.en: This Session is outside the share you hold, so it was not written

messages.zh: 分享者已把此分享改为仅可查看
messages.en: The owner set this share to read only

messages.zh: 这次发送没有可供署名的请求标识，Host 没有执行
messages.en: This send carried no request identity to attribute, so the Host did not run it

messages.zh: 分享者已不允许写入此会话
messages.en: The owner does not allow writing this Session

messages.zh: 分支请求指向的会话不是该分享的会话
messages.en: The branch named a different Session than the share carries

messages.zh: 此 Host 未能限制共享会话的执行，因此无法驱动它
messages.en: This Host could not confine the shared Session, so it cannot drive it

messages.zh: 无法确认该分享的当前状态，确认前保持只读
messages.en: This share’s current state could not be confirmed; it stays read-only until it is

messages.zh: 你的账号已无权访问该分享
messages.en: Your account no longer has access to this share
This deployment does not support writing yet

messages.zh: 登录状态已失效，请重新登录。
messages.en: Your sign-in expired. Please sign in again.

messages.zh: liveshare：中继未对 {subject} 返回内容
messages.en: liveshare: the Relay answered nothing for {subject}

messages.zh: 分享者已停止或撤销你的访问。
messages.en: The owner stopped sharing or revoked your access.

messages.zh: 此页面无法打开工作区文件：分享提供的是文件路径，不是文件内容。
messages.en: This page cannot open workspace files: a share hands over file paths, not file contents.

messages.zh: 请联系分享者重新分享。
messages.en: Ask the owner to share the session again.

messages.zh: 链接无效，或这条分享已被删除。
messages.en: This link is not valid, or that share was deleted.

messages.zh: 请检查链接是否完整；也可以找分享者要一条新链接。
messages.en: Check that the link is complete, or ask the owner for a new one.

messages.zh: 分享者当前不在线，会自动重连。
messages.en: The owner is offline right now; this page reconnects automatically.

messages.zh: 稍等片刻或点「重试」；长时间仍然离线请联系分享者。
messages.en: Wait a moment or choose Retry; if it stays offline, contact the owner.

messages.zh: 分享者已停止这条分享。
如需继续访问，请联系分享者重新开启。
messages.en: Ask the owner to turn it back on if you still need access.

messages.zh: 服务暂时不可用，正在重试。
messages.en: The share service is unavailable right now; retrying.

messages.zh: 请稍后重试；持续不可用请联系分享者或稍后再来。
messages.en: Try again shortly; if it stays unavailable, come back later.

messages.zh: liveshare：{subject} 未能送达中继，正在重试
messages.en: liveshare: {subject} did not reach the Relay, retrying

messages.zh: 分享者已授予写入，但这个会话当前无法被驱动；就绪后即可发送消息。
messages.en: The owner granted writing, but this session cannot be driven right now; sending becomes available once it is prepared.

messages.zh: 选择本会话使用的模型
messages.en: Select the model for this conversation

messages.zh: 当前模型未提供推理等级。
messages.en: This model provides no reasoning effort levels.

messages.zh: 当前会话已被占用，可能是其他正在运行的 DSH 导致的（如其他 dsh web、桌面端），请退出其他正在运行的 DSH 后重试。
messages.en: This session is already in use, possibly by another running DSH instance (such as dsh web or the desktop app). Quit other running DSH instances and try again.

messages.zh: 选择模型，当前 {model}，推理等级 {effort}
无法复制，请检查内容是否可用后重试
messages.en: Could not copy. Check that the content is available, then retry.

messages.zh: 无法显示文件位置，请重试
messages.en: Could not show the file location. Try again.

messages.zh: 已在其它设备显示文件位置
messages.en: File location shown on another device

messages.zh: 当前工作区或本地应用不可用
messages.en: Current workspace or local application unavailable

messages.zh: 我已了解这些风险，并愿意继续
messages.en: I understand these risks and want to continue

messages.zh: 自动审查不使用沙箱。每次原生工具调用和 PTC 内层调用前，都会由与当前 agent 相同的模型进行审查；审查拒绝的调用由你批准或拒绝。此功能仍属实验性，可能误放行或误拒绝，并会消耗额外 token。
messages.en: Auto review runs without a sandbox. Before every native tool call and PTC inner call, the same model as the current agent reviews whether to allow it; you approve or reject each call it denies. This feature is experimental, can falsely allow or deny actions, and uses additional tokens.

messages.zh: 确认启用自动审查（实验）？
无沙箱运行；每次原生工具调用和 PTC 内层调用前由同一模型进行实验性审查。
messages.en: Run without a sandbox after an experimental same-model review of every native tool call and PTC inner call.

messages.zh: 我已了解风险，并愿意继续
messages.en: I understand the risks and want to continue

messages.zh: 本次选择同时应用于当前会话和之后新建的会话；其他已有会话不变。完全访问不再逐次请求 DSH 工具审批；Android 和设备系统授权仍单独处理。
messages.en: Apply Full access to this session and the default for new sessions; other existing sessions stay unchanged. DSH tool approval prompts are disabled. Android and device system permissions remain separate.

messages.zh: 计划模式已开启，按下关闭
messages.en: Plan mode on, press to turn off

messages.zh: 计划模式已开启 — 点击关闭（/plan off）
messages.en: Plan mode on — click to turn off (/plan off)

messages.zh: 临时计划预览已失效，请从仍在等待审批的卡片重新打开。
messages.en: This temporary plan preview has expired. Reopen it from the pending review card.
Choose how to add a plugin

messages.zh: 卸载后它提供的功能会消失。
messages.en: What it provides goes away once it is uninstalled.

messages.zh: 插件声明的详细介绍文件无效
messages.en: The plugin declares an invalid details file.

messages.zh: 无法连接到详细介绍的来源
messages.en: Could not reach the source of the details.

messages.zh: 详细介绍超过大小限制，未加载
messages.en: The details exceed the size limit and were not loaded.

messages.zh: 可能由于网络问题，无法读取全部插件
messages.en: Could not read all plugins, possibly due to a network problem

messages.zh: 在这里配置官方插件，安装和管理其他插件。内置插件列表及运行状态可在「设置 → 内置插件」中查看
messages.en: Configure official plugins and install or manage other plugins here. View the built-in plugin list and runtime status in Settings → Built-in plugins.

messages.zh: 取消请求未得到确认；安装已进入收尾阶段，请等待结果。{reason}
messages.en: Cancellation was not confirmed. Installation is being applied; wait for its result. {reason}

messages.zh: 只在信任这些包时允许。
允许后，脚本会以你的权限在本机运行，授权保存在当前 profile，之后不再询问。
messages.en: Once allowed, the scripts run here with your permissions, and the permission is saved in this profile.

messages.zh: 以下包声明了安装脚本，pnpm 默认不运行。
messages.en: These packages have install scripts that pnpm did not run.

messages.zh: {previous} 不可用，正在改用 {registry} 重试（第 {index} 个源，共 {total} 个）
messages.en: {previous} could not serve the package; retrying through {registry} (registry {index} of {total})

messages.zh: 正在等待后端接收安装任务，收到确认后会自动重试取消。
messages.en: Waiting for the Host to accept installation. Cancellation will retry automatically after confirmation.

messages.zh: 安装已进入收尾阶段，无法取消，可查看安装进度。
messages.en: Installation is being applied and cannot be cancelled. View installation progress.

插件安装失败，可查看安装详情。
安装状态暂未确认，请查看安装任务了解详情。
messages.en: Installation status is unconfirmed. View the installation for details.

messages.en: Installation result unavailable. Check the plugin list.

messages.zh: 无需下载，启用即可使用
messages.en: Enable it without downloading another copy

messages.en: Cancel installation and return to editing

messages.en: Installation has not been confirmed stopped. Retry cancellation or wait for the installation result. {reason}

messages.zh: 已取消安装，插件未启用，下载的文件可能保留
messages.en: Installation cancelled; the plugin is not enabled, and downloaded files may remain

messages.zh: 输入插件的包名、GitHub 仓库地址或本地目录路径。
messages.en: Enter the plugin's package name, GitHub repository address, or local directory path.

messages.zh: 本次安装详情没有收到终端输出
messages.en: No terminal output from this install reached the details

messages.zh: 安装完成，没有新增依赖。
messages.en: Install finished with no new dependency.

messages.zh: 根据 pnpm 供应链安全策略（minimumReleaseAge），发布时间未满规定时长的版本不会被自动安装，因此本次安装的是 {installed}，而非最新版本 {version}。新发布的版本尚未经过该观察期，可能存在未被发现的恶意代码或缺陷。如确需使用 {version}，请先卸载当前版本，再安装 {exact} 以指定该版本。
messages.en: Under pnpm's supply-chain security policy (minimumReleaseAge), versions published more recently than the required age are not installed automatically, so this installation used {installed} instead of the latest version {version}. A newly published version has not completed this waiting period and may contain undetected malicious code or defects. If you need {version}, uninstall the current version and then install {exact} to request that version.

messages.zh: 已安装，请重启 DSH 加载它。{reason}
messages.en: Installed; restart DSH to load it. {reason}

messages.zh:
### 可以创造什么

创造模式具备标准任务工具，并增加运行时检查，以及 Cordis 插件和 Agent 预设的开发指引。可以编写插件来添加功能或界面，也可以组合工具和提示词，创建适合特定任务的模式。

### 插件与模式的关系

插件为 DSH 增加能力，例如工具、服务连接或界面入口。模式是一份 Agent 预设，用来选择任务可用的工具，并约定 Agent 的工作方式。自定义模式中也可以使用自己开发的插件。

### 怎样让成果生效

可以要求 Agent 完成安装并验证实际效果。插件可能即时加载，也可能需要重启，取决于修改内容；新建的模式在创建新任务时选择。
messages.en:
### What you can create

Creator mode includes the standard task tools plus runtime inspection and guidance for authoring Cordis plugins and agent presets. It can create a plugin that adds a capability or UI, or a preset that combines tools and prompts for a particular job.

### Plugins and modes

A plugin adds capabilities to DSH, such as a tool, a service connection, or a UI entry. A mode is an agent preset that selects tools and defines how the agent works in a task. A plugin can be included in a custom preset.

### How the result takes effect

Ask the agent to install and verify the result, not just generate source code. A plugin may load immediately or require a restart, depending on what it changes. A newly created preset is selected when starting a new task.

messages.zh: 新建任务时选择「创造模式」，说明希望增加什么能力、从哪里使用，以及怎样验证效果。
messages.en: Choose Creator mode for a new task. Describe the capability you want, where it should appear, and how you will verify it.

messages.zh:
### 添加一个界面

> 帮我写一个 DSH 插件，在侧栏增加「项目笔记」入口，列出当前工作区的 Markdown 文件，点击后能预览内容。完成安装并验证页面能打开。

预期产出：带侧栏入口和预览页的插件，以及仍需完成的生效步骤。

### 添加一个工具

> 写一个插件，提供读取项目测试报告、汇总失败用例的工具。注册工具，并用一份示例报告验证调用结果。

预期产出：可调用的新工具，以及一次示例调用的验证结果。

### 创建自己的模式

> 基于标准模式创建「代码审查」模式，优先检查潜在错误和测试缺口，指出文件与行号，修改文件前先询问我。保存成可选择的预设。

预期产出：可在新任务中选择的自定义模式。审查要求用于指导 Agent，实际可执行的操作仍由权限设置决定。
messages.en:
### Add a UI

> Create a DSH plugin that adds a project notes entry to the sidebar. Let me browse the Markdown files in this workspace and preview a selected note. Install it and verify that the page opens.

Expected output: an installed plugin with a working entry and preview page, plus any remaining activation steps.

### Add a tool

> Create a plugin with a tool that reads this project’s test report and summarizes the failed tests. Register it and verify it with a sample report.

Expected output: a plugin with a callable tool and a verified sample call.

### Create my own mode

> Create a “Code review” mode based on Standard mode. Have it prioritize potential bugs and test gaps, cite file paths and lines, and ask before modifying files. Save it as a selectable preset.

Expected output: a custom preset for new tasks. These review instructions guide the agent; permission settings determine which actions it can execute.

messages.zh:
### 保留哪些能力

提供持久 Shell 和 read_image 工具，并使用固定系统提示词。读取图片需要支持图片输入的模型。上下文压力达到阈值时自动压缩较早历史；Agent 空闲时可输入 /compact 手动压缩。内置预设不加载 Skills、计划，也不注入标准运行时上下文。

### 什么时候选

适合作为实验和对照测试的基线。Agent 仍能通过终端命令读写文件、运行脚本，但缺少管理长任务的内置辅助能力。工具少，不代表对新手更容易。
messages.en:
### What is included

One persistent shell tool, read_image, and a fixed system prompt. Image reading requires an image-capable model. Older history is compacted automatically under context pressure; use /compact while the agent is idle to compact it manually. The built-in preset does not load Skills, planning, or the standard runtime context.

### When to choose it

Use it as a baseline for experiments and comparisons. It can still read files and execute scripts through shell commands, but offers fewer built-in ways to manage a long task. Fewer tools does not necessarily make it easier for a beginner.

messages.zh: 新建任务时选择「极简模式」。做对照测试时，保持模型、权限、任务输入和工作区起始状态一致。
messages.en: Choose Minimal mode for a new task. For a comparison, hold the model, permissions, input, and starting workspace state constant across runs.

messages.zh:
### 对比基础修复表现

> 运行这个项目的测试，找出失败原因，做最小修复，再运行相关测试并报告结果。

分别用标准模式和极简模式，从相同的工作区状态执行这条任务，对比完成情况、工具调用和最终修改。极简模式会通过终端命令完成这些操作。
messages.en:
### Compare performance on a small bug fix

> Run the tests for this project, find the cause of the failure, and make the smallest fix. Run the relevant tests again and report the result.

Run the same task separately in Standard and Minimal modes from the same starting state. Compare task completion, tool calls, and the resulting changes. Minimal mode performs the work through terminal commands.

messages.zh:
### 怎样调用工具

PTC 是 Programmatic Tool Calling，即通过程序调用工具。当前内置预设让 Agent 通过 run_code 编写 TypeScript 程序，使用生成的工具 SDK 发起调用。程序可以组织循环、条件判断、错误处理，以及适合并发执行的调用。

### 哪些结果交给模型

工具返回的数据先交给程序，经过筛选、计算或合并，再通过输出或返回值交给模型；图片结果会另行附加。程序中的工具调用仍会被记录，也仍受工具权限约束。

### 与标准模式的区别

两种模式都能编程、批量处理文件。标准模式直接向模型提供各个工具；PTC 让模型用代码组织工具调用。当前 PTC 预设未启用 workflow 和插件管理工具。速度和 token 用量取决于具体任务与结果处理方式。
messages.en:
### How tools are called

PTC means Programmatic Tool Calling. In this built-in preset, the agent uses run_code to write a TypeScript program that calls tools through a generated SDK. The program can use loops, conditions, error handling, and concurrent calls where appropriate.

### What reaches the model

Tool results first reach the program, which can filter and combine them. The model receives what the program prints or returns; image results are attached separately. Nested tool calls are still recorded and remain subject to tool permissions.

### Compared with Standard mode

Both modes can handle coding and batch tasks. Standard mode exposes individual tools directly; PTC organizes tool calls in code. The current PTC preset leaves the workflow and plugin management tools disabled. Speed and token use depend on the task and how the program handles its results.

messages.zh: 新建任务时选择「PTC 模式」，说明输入文件、处理规则和输出格式。代码由 Agent 编写。
messages.en: Choose PTC mode when starting a new task. Specify the input files, processing rules, and output format. The agent writes the code.

messages.zh:
### 批量检查配置文件

> 检查 configs/ 下所有 JSON 文件，按照 schema.json 找出缺失字段和不合法的值。每个问题写成 CSV 中的一行；读取失败的文件也记入报告，继续检查其余文件。保留原文件。

预期产出：问题汇总和一份 CSV 报告。程序可以对多份文件执行相同检查，处理单个文件的失败，再汇总结果。

### 汇总错误日志

> 分析 logs/ 下的日志，按服务和错误类型统计次数，列出出现最多的十类错误，每类保留一条示例。完整统计另存为 CSV。

预期产出：高频错误摘要和完整统计表。中间数据可以先在程序中聚合，再把汇总交给模型。
messages.en:
### Check a set of configuration files

> Check all JSON files in configs/. List missing required fields and invalid values against schema.json. Save a CSV with one row per issue. Include unreadable files in the report and keep checking the rest. Leave the original files unchanged.

Expected output: an issue summary and a CSV report. The program can repeat the same checks, handle individual failures, and collect the results.

### Summarize error logs

> Analyze the log files in logs/. Group errors by service and error type. Show the ten most frequent groups and one example from each. Save the full counts to a CSV.

Expected output: the top error groups and a complete count table. Intermediate data can be aggregated in the program before the summary reaches the model.

messages.zh:
### 工作方式

Agent 直接调用工具来读写文件、检索资料和执行终端命令。包含 Skills、计划、目标、子 Agent、工作流、插件管理和上下文压缩等能力。

### 什么时候选

日常编程、文件处理和资料整理可以从这里开始。标准模式也能编写脚本、批量处理文件；PTC 改变的是工具调用方式，批量任务并不必须使用 PTC。
messages.en:
### How it works

The agent calls tools directly to read and edit files, search, and run terminal commands. It includes Skills, planning, goals, subagents, workflows, plugin management, and context compaction.

### When to choose it

Start here for everyday coding, file work, and research. Standard mode can also write scripts and process files in batches. PTC changes how tool calls are organized; it is not required for batch tasks.

messages.zh: 新建任务时选择「标准模式」，说明要完成什么、相关文件在哪里，以及怎样判断任务完成。
messages.en: Choose Standard mode when starting a new task. Describe what you want to accomplish, point to the relevant files, and explain how to check the result.

messages.zh:
### 修复一个问题

> 搜索表单连续提交两次后，结果会消失。请定位原因、修复问题并运行相关测试，最后说明原因和修改内容。

预期产出：代码修改、相关测试结果，以及问题原因说明。

### 整理项目资料

> 阅读项目中的 Markdown 记录，整理已经达成的结论和仍待确认的问题，并附上对应文件链接。

预期产出：一份带来源引用的总结，方便回到原文核对。
messages.en:
### Fix a bug

> Find out why submitting the search form twice makes the results disappear. Fix it and run the relevant tests. Explain the cause and what changed.

Expected output: a code change, the relevant test results, and an explanation of the cause.

### Organize project notes

> Read the Markdown notes in this project. Summarize the agreed decisions and open questions, with links to the source files.

Expected output: a summary with references that you can check against the original notes.

messages.zh:
DeepSeek Harness 目前的 0.2 版本仍处于预览阶段，还有许多地方需要持续改进和打磨，希望听取广大开发者和用户的反馈建议。现在，新的桌面端面向广泛用户，开发者相关的进阶功能可在配置中开启使用。预计 DeepSeek Harness 的产品功能以及插件 API 都会继续快速迭代、持续演化，并逐渐趋于稳定。

我们期待与全球用户和开发者一起，在开源、可复用、可组合的基础设施之上，共同探索智能上限。欢迎大家用 DeepSeek Harness 将想法变成现实，与社区一起丰富插件生态。
messages.en:
DeepSeek Harness 0.2 is still in preview, and many areas need continued improvement and refinement. We welcome feedback and suggestions from all developers and users. The new desktop app now targets a broad range of users, while developer-related advanced features can be enabled in the settings. DeepSeek Harness’s product features and plugin APIs are expected to continue rapid iteration and evolution, and will gradually stabilize over time.

We look forward to exploring the limits of intelligence together with users and developers around the world, building on open-source, reusable, and composable infrastructure. We welcome everyone to bring their ideas to life with DeepSeek Harness and participate in the community to enrich the plugin ecosystem.

messages.zh: 文件在读取时已更改，请重新打开预览。
messages.en: The file changed while being read. Reopen the preview.

messages.zh: Office 转换失败，未生成可用的 PDF。请检查该文件后重试。
messages.en: Office conversion did not produce a usable PDF. Check the file and try again.

messages.zh: 无法预览此 Office 文件。文件可能已损坏、受密码保护，或与扩展名不符。
messages.en: This Office file cannot be previewed. It may be damaged, password protected, or have the wrong extension.

messages.zh: 本次预览无法使用以下字体，预览中的文字和排版可能与原文档不同。
messages.en: These fonts are unavailable for this preview. Text and layout may differ from the original document.
Office conversion timed out. Try again.

messages.zh: Office 文件或转换后的 PDF 超过预览大小上限，请缩小文件或调整预览配置。
messages.en: The Office file or converted PDF exceeds the preview size limit. Reduce the file size or adjust the preview configuration.

messages.zh: Office 预览不可用。请在运行 DeepSeek Harness 的主机上启用文档预览服务。
messages.en: Office previews are unavailable. Enable the document preview service on the computer running DeepSeek Harness.

messages.zh: 缺失 {count} 种字体，点击查看
此 PDF 需要密码，暂不支持预览
messages.en: This PDF requires a password; password-protected previews are not supported.

messages.zh: PDF 预览需要完整文件内容
messages.en: PDF preview requires the complete file contents.

messages.zh: PDF 渲染进程无法继续，请重试
messages.en: The PDF rendering process could not continue. Please retry.

messages.zh: 浮动面板不支持此操作
messages.en: This action is unavailable in a floating panel
Focus a right sidebar pane first

messages.zh: 页面已切换，请重新聚焦
messages.en: The page changed; focus it again

messages.zh: 栏宽不足，拖宽侧边栏后再分栏
messages.en: Not enough width to split, widen the sidebar

messages.zh: 栏宽不足，拖宽侧边栏后再分栏
messages.en: Not enough width to split, widen the sidebar

messages.zh: 这类内容还没有可用的查看方式。
messages.en: Nothing here can view this kind of content yet.

messages.zh: 终端连接已结束，请重新连接。
messages.en: The terminal connection ended. Reconnect to continue.

messages.zh: 在会话工作区运行命令
messages.en: Run commands in the Session workspace

messages.zh: 输入缓冲区已满，请重新连接后重试。
messages.en: The input buffer is full. Reconnect and try again.

messages.zh: 终端画面传输异常，请重新连接。
messages.en: The terminal screen could not be received. Reconnect to recover it.

messages.zh: 此终端已不存在，请新建终端。
messages.en: This terminal no longer exists. Open a new terminal.

messages.zh: 终端数量已达上限，请关闭不用的终端后重试。已退出的终端也计入数量。
messages.en: The terminal limit has been reached. Close unused terminals and try again. Exited terminals also count toward the limit.

messages.zh: 还没结束，这是已用时间
messages.en: not finished yet: this is elapsed time

messages.zh: 缓存读 {read} · 输入 {input} · 缓存写 {write}
缓存读 ÷（输入 + 缓存读 + 缓存写）：提示词里命中缓存的比例
messages.en: cache read ÷ (input + cache read + cache write): the share of the prompt served from cache

messages.zh: 该步 usage 的输入词数 + 缓存读 + 缓存写
messages.en: usage input tokens + cache read + cache write

messages.zh: 该步调用的工具与次数；没有工具调用的步显示回答正文的摘要
messages.en: Tools this step called and how often; a step without tool calls previews its answer text

messages.zh: 步开始到收到完整回复（含首 token 延迟）
messages.en: step start to the settled reply (includes the first-token delay)

messages.zh: 该步 usage 的输出词数
messages.en: usage output tokens of the step

messages.zh: 这一轮是由什么触发的；人写的提示词显示正文，自动触发显示来源标签
messages.en: What opened this turn: a human prompt shows its text, automation shows a source badge

messages.zh: 轮次行是该轮的合计；点一行展开或折叠它的每一步
messages.en: A turn row holds the turn total; click a row to expand or collapse its steps

messages.zh: 总用时拆分：浅蓝 首 token、蓝 生成、橙 工具调用、灰 其余。条长按平方根刻度，步只和同一轮的步比，轮只和轮比
messages.en: total split: light blue first token, blue generation, orange tool calls, gray everything else. Bar length uses a square-root scale; steps compare only with steps of the same turn, turns with turns

messages.zh: 该步内每次工具调用到拿到结果的耗时之和；还没有结果的调用不计
messages.en: sum of every tool call up to its result inside the step; calls without a result are excluded

messages.zh: 输出词数 ÷ 生成秒数（TPS，tok/s）
步开始到第一个输出片段（TTFT）
messages.en: step start to the first output fragment (TTFT)

messages.zh: 压缩调用单独展示，不并入轮次的步骤合计
messages.en: Compaction runs are shown separately and excluded from the turn's step totals

messages.zh: 相对同轮上一步的提示词增量；负值表示上下文减少（如压缩）
messages.en: Prompt delta against the previous measured step in the turn; negative means the context shrank (for example after compaction)

messages.zh: 轮次行显示该轮各步提示词大小之和（累计处理量）；合计行始终为累计值
messages.en: Turn rows show the sum of prompt sizes across the turn's steps (cumulative processing); the total row stays cumulative

messages.zh: 轮次行显示最后一步的提示词大小（最终上下文）；合计行始终为累计值
messages.en: Turn rows show the last measured step's prompt size (final context); the total row stays cumulative

messages.zh: 回答过长，仅展示前 16,000 字符
messages.en: Answer is long; only the first 16,000 chars are kept

messages.zh: 这条调用没有留下正文
还有 {count} 次调用没有列出（一步最多列 {limit} 次）
messages.en: {count} more calls are not listed (at most {limit} per step)

messages.zh: 只显示前 {shown} 行，共 {total} 行
查看原始 JSON 参数
点这一行展开或收起工具详情
messages.en: Click this row to expand or collapse the tool details

messages.zh: 内容过长，这里只保留了前 {chars} 字符
messages.en: Too long: only the first {chars} characters are kept

messages.zh: 长行换行显示，不出现横向滚动
messages.en: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways

messages.zh: 本步工具输出合计 {chars} 字符，会进入下一步的上下文
messages.en: {chars} characters of tool output in this step; they become part of the next prompt

messages.zh: 当前窗口里还没有可以测量的步骤。
messages.en: No measurable step in the current window.

messages.zh: 未提交消息的模型尝试
messages.en: Model attempt without a committed message

messages.zh: 第 {retry} 次重试 · 等待 {delay}
非步骤事件行：解释请求、提示词、工具集、重试、上下文刷新、审批和裁剪变化，不计入轮次的步骤合计
messages.en: Non-step event rows: request, prompt, tool-set, retry, context-refresh, approval, and prune changes excluded from the turn step totals

messages.zh: 悬停或聚焦预览这一轮的图片，点击查看大图
messages.en: Hover or focus to preview this turn's images; click to open the full image

messages.zh: 查看第 {index} 张图（共 {count} 张）
还有 {count} 次工具调用没有拿到结果，这里是已知耗时的下限
messages.en: {count} tool calls have no result yet; this is the lower bound of known time

messages.zh: 该步已经结束，但没有收到完整回复（多为被取消或失败）
messages.en: The step closed without a settled reply (usually cancelled or failed)

messages.zh: 这一步的提示词几乎没命中缓存：进程重启、会话恢复后的第一次请求都是这样，输入按全价计
messages.en: The prompt barely hit the cache: usually the first request after a restart or a session resume, paid at full input price

messages.zh: 这一步的开始与结束事件不在当前事件窗口里（页签重连或窗口重建时被截断），首 token、模型用时、总用时都没有起点可以相减；重新加载页签会从完整窗口重新装配
messages.en: This step's start and end events are not in the current event window (trimmed while the tab reconnected or the window was rebuilt), so first-token, model time and total have no start to subtract from; reloading the tab reassembles from the full window

messages.zh: 展开或折叠第 {step} 步的工具详情
messages.en: Expand or collapse the tool details of step {step}

messages.zh: 该步有 {count} 次工具调用返回错误结果
messages.en: {count} tool calls in this step returned an error result

messages.zh: 整段会话合计；总用时为模型用时 + 工具用时（不含跨轮空隙）
messages.en: Totals for the complete session; total time is model time + tool time (no inter-turn gaps)

messages.zh: 当前已加载窗口的合计；上下文为各步累计值
messages.en: Totals for the turns loaded in this window; the context cell is cumulative across steps

messages.zh: 展开或折叠这一轮的每一步
messages.en: Expand or collapse the steps of this turn

messages.zh: 收起 {label} 的下级子智能体
展开 {label} 的下级子智能体
父会话当前不在线，重新打开父会话后即可继续发送消息。
messages.en: The parent session is offline; reopen it to continue sending messages.

messages.zh: 一次性任务不支持后续消息，可在这里查看完整执行记录。
messages.en: One-shot tasks do not accept follow-ups; review the full execution record here.
This subagent is read-only for now

messages.zh: 读取子会话后才能确定是否可继续。
messages.en: Read the child session to determine whether it can be continued.

messages.zh: 打开第 {index} 个块的工具调用概述
拖动调整大小；双击恢复默认值。
messages.en: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.

messages.zh: 上下文压缩在完成前被中断。
系统提示词和工具已更新
新增 {added} 个，移除 {removed} 个
原始结果仅在实时工具调用中可用
messages.en: Raw results are only available for live tool calls

messages.zh: 本次请求没有系统提示词
messages.en: No system prompt in this request

messages.zh: 时间线概览；水平拖动可聚焦事件
messages.en: Timeline overview; drag horizontally to focus events

messages.zh: 首 token 时间不可用
输出 token 数不可用
音频将发送至所选云端服务。
messages.en: Audio will be sent to the selected cloud service.

messages.zh: 草稿已被修改。识别文字已保留，可在当前光标位置插入。
messages.en: Your draft changed. The transcript is preserved and can be inserted at the current cursor.

messages.zh: 麦克风不可用，请选择其他输入设备
messages.en: Microphone unavailable. Choose another input device.

messages.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：安全连接的证书校验失败。
无法下载 {resource}：无法解析下载地址。
messages.en: Cannot download {resource}: the download address could not be resolved.

messages.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：下载服务返回 HTTP {status}。
messages.en: Cannot download {resource}: the download service returned HTTP {status}.

messages.zh: {resource} 下载不完整或文件校验失败。
messages.en: The download of {resource} is incomplete or failed verification.

messages.zh: 无法下载 {resource}：连接下载服务失败。
messages.en: Cannot download {resource}: connection to the download service failed.

messages.zh: 无法保存 {resource}：磁盘空间不足或没有写入权限。
messages.en: Cannot save {resource}: insufficient disk space or write permission.

messages.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的系统时间、受信任证书和代理设置后重试。
messages.en: Check the system clock, trusted certificates and proxy settings on the machine running DSH, then retry.

messages.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的 DNS 和代理设置，确认可以解析下载来源的域名后重试。
messages.en: Check DNS and proxy settings on the machine running DSH. Confirm that it can resolve the download source domain, then retry.

messages.zh: 请确认下载地址可用、代理可正常连接下载服务，或稍后重试。
messages.en: Confirm that the download address is available and the proxy can reach the download service, or retry later.

messages.zh: 请重试下载。已完成并通过校验的其他文件会保留。
messages.en: Retry the download. Other completed and verified files are retained.

messages.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器能否访问下载来源及其模型下载服务；如需代理，请在该机器上配置后重试。
messages.en: Check that the machine running DSH can reach the download source and its model download services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed, then retry.

messages.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的剩余磁盘空间，以及模型目录的写入权限后重试。
messages.en: Check available disk space and write permission for the model directory on the machine running DSH, then retry.

messages.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的网络或代理连接，稍后重试。已下载并通过校验的文件会保留。
messages.en: Check the network or proxy connection on the machine running DSH, then retry later. Verified downloaded files are retained.

messages.zh: 请检查运行 DSH 的机器的网络、磁盘空间和模型目录权限后重试。
messages.en: Check the network, disk space and model directory permissions on the machine running DSH, then retry.
Recording was interrupted. Please try again.

messages.zh: 音频在运行 DSH 的机器上识别。需要下载模型时，请确保该机器能访问所选下载源及其文件服务。如需代理，请在该机器上配置。
messages.en: Audio is recognized on the machine running DSH. If models need downloading, that machine must be able to reach the selected source and its file services. Configure a proxy on that machine if needed.

messages.zh: 麦克风权限未开启，请在浏览器和系统设置中允许访问。
messages.en: Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings.

messages.zh: 准备已取消，已完成的下载会保留。
messages.en: Preparation cancelled. Completed downloads are retained.

messages.zh: 本地资源已准备，录音时自动唤醒。
messages.en: Local resources are prepared. Recording wakes the recognizer.

messages.zh: 首次使用需要下载本地识别模型。
messages.en: First use downloads the local recognition models.

messages.zh: 建议预留约 {gb} GB，包含模型、运行时和下载缓存
messages.en: Allow about {gb} GB for models, runtime, and download caches

messages.zh: 以上为估算；网络较慢时可能更久。已下载的资源会复用，默认在闲置后释放模型内存。
messages.en: These are estimates; slow networks may take longer. Downloads are reused; idle models release memory by default.

messages.zh: 将在运行 DSH 的机器上下载本地模型，无需安装 Python 或编译工具。
messages.en: Local models will be downloaded to the machine running DSH. No Python or compiler is required.

messages.zh: 模型加载后约 {gb} GB，识别时可能更高
messages.en: About {gb} GB with the model loaded; recognition may use more

messages.zh: 参考 {min}–{max} 分钟，取决于网络和机器性能
messages.en: Allow roughly {min}–{max} minutes, depending on the network and machine

messages.zh: 语音输入插件已开启。首次使用需要在本机下载并准备识别模型，请前往插件详情页查看空间、内存和时间说明，再开始安装。
messages.en: Voice input is enabled. First use requires downloading and preparing local recognition models. Open the plugin details to review disk space, memory and time estimates before starting setup.

messages.zh: 使用语音输入前需要安装
messages.en: Set up voice input before recording

messages.zh: 请前往语音插件详情页查看识别服务状态、准备进度或错误信息
messages.en: Open the voice plugin details to check recognition status, preparation progress, or errors.

messages.zh: 优先使用响应较快的源，下载失败时自动尝试其他源。
messages.en: Prefer the first responding source and try another if a download fails.

messages.zh: 仅从所选源下载；已下载并通过校验的文件会复用。
messages.en: Download only from the selected source. Verified downloaded files are reused.

messages.zh: 录音超过服务限制，请缩短录音后重试。
messages.en: The recording exceeds the service limit. Try a shorter recording.

messages.zh: 当前浏览器不支持录音，请使用支持麦克风的浏览器。
messages.en: This browser cannot record audio. Use a browser with microphone support.

messages.zh: “{title}”仍有正在进行的工作。归档会先停止这些工作；之后可在侧栏筛选“全部对话（显示已归档）”中恢复会话，被停止的工作不会自动继续。
messages.en: “{title}” still has work in progress. Archiving stops it first; you can restore the session later from the “All conversations (show archived)” filter in the sidebar, and the stopped work will not resume on its own.

messages.zh: 无法创建默认工作区，请通过“选择工作区”选择文件夹
messages.en: Unable to create default workspace. Use Choose workspace to select a folder.

messages.zh: 将把“{name}”从工作区列表中移除。文件夹与会话记录会保留，其会话将显示在“未分组”下。
messages.en: This removes “{name}” from the workspace list. The folder and session logs will be kept. Its sessions will appear under Ungrouped.

messages.zh: 暂时无法填入草稿，请稍后重试
messages.en: Could not fill the draft. Please try again shortly.

messages.zh: 单击或轻触打开；Enter 或空格打开
messages.en: Click or tap to open. Enter or Space opens.

messages.zh: 仅显示前 {n} 条结果，请缩小搜索范围。
messages.en: Showing the first {n} results. Narrow your search.

messages.zh: 正在选择或添加工作区

messages.en: Could not fork the session. Try again.

messages.zh: 当前会话没有已结束的轮次
messages.en: This session has no completed turn

messages.zh: 已归档对话暂时无法查看，请取消归档后查看
messages.en: Archived sessions cannot be opened. Unarchive it to view.

messages.zh: 请先打开原会话完成迁移，再创建分支
messages.en: Open the original session to complete migration before creating a branch.
Session stopped and archived. You can

messages.zh: 取消置顶失败，请稍后重试
